{{Quote|I hope you remember this and one day do me a favor. He's not that far away. He's at the Spider Arms Hostel.|[[Jan Dez/Legends|Jan Dez]] when asked about the whereabouts of the pickpocket [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]]|<ref name="Lightsaber Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref>}}
The '''Spider Arms Hostel''' was an [[Hotel/Legends|establishment]] located in [[Slum district G17/Legends|slum district G17]] of the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Patrolian/Legends|Patrolian]] pickpocket [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]] was based out of one of its rooms.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Even though the hostel is called Spider Arms, above the entrance, "SPIDER ''ARM''" is written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]].
